name: Rock
description: Punchy low end for kick and bass, slightly tamed low-mid mud, and a clear presence region so guitars and vocals cut through a dense mix.

hints.rationale: Add weight and punch to kick drum and bass guitar.
Reduce low-mid congestion so the wall of guitars stays clean.
Bring guitar and vocal body forward in the mix.
Add bite and edge to electric guitars and snare crack.
A little air and sparkle for cymbals.

name: Vocal Focus
description: Pushes the vocal forward and intelligible while trimming masking energy below and harshness above the voice.

hints.rationale: Clear boxy low-mid energy that masks the voice.
Add fundamental body and presence to the vocal.
Lift the presence region for intelligibility and forwardness.
Tame sibilance so the boosted presence stays comfortable.

name: FPS Footsteps
description: Competitive-gaming tuning that exaggerates footstep and reload cues in the upper-mids while cutting masking bass rumble.

hints.rationale: Reduce explosion and music rumble that masks small cues.
Pull down low-mid clutter for a cleaner soundstage.
Emphasize footstep and reload transients for positional clarity.
Sharpen high-frequency detail of distant steps.

name: Late Night
description: Low-fatigue listening at quiet volumes: a touch more bass and reduced harsh treble so detail survives without sharpness.

hints.rationale: Restore perceived bass that is lost at low volume (equal-loudness).
Soften forward presence for relaxed listening.
Cut harsh upper treble that fatigues over long sessions.
Gently roll off the very top end for smoothness.

name: Bass Boost
description: Clean low-end emphasis for electronic and hip-hop: deep sub weight without smearing the mids.

hints.rationale: Deliver sub-bass rumble and slam.
Reinforce mid-bass punch for kick body.
Keep the boosted bass from muddying the lower mids.

name: Podcast / Speech
description: Maximizes spoken-word clarity and consistency: trimmed lows, lifted presence, and controlled sibilance.

hints.rationale: Remove rumble and plosive energy below the voice.
Reduce muddiness for a clear, articulate tone.
Boost intelligibility of consonants and presence.
Control sibilance and ess sounds.

name: Harman Neutral
description: A reference-style balanced target with a gentle bass shelf and natural presence — a safe, accurate baseline for most headphones.

hints.rationale: The Harman bass shelf adds perceived naturalness and warmth.
Slight low-mid relief keeps the balance clean.
Gentle ear-gain presence for natural vocal placement.
A touch of air for openness without harshness.

name: Crinacle IEF Preference 2025
description: Crinacle's 2025 In-Ear Fidelity preference target: JM-1/IEF-style reference voicing with strong sub-bass weight and a relaxed treble shelf. For IEMs this follows the IEC 711 article parameters; for headphones use it as a preference direction, not literal compensation.

hints.rationale: IEC 711 IEF Preference 2025 uses the standard 105 Hz bass shelf at about +8 dB for strong low-end preference weight.
Crinacle's 2025 preference target pairs the bass shelf with a -4 dB treble adjustment rather than a full-spectrum tilt.
